description: Carry config for a patched Buzz build. Copy to patch-commits.json beside the scripts and fill in. Read by check-upstream.ps1 and rebase-patches.ps1; humans edit it, scripts never do. Update base_ref and current_branch after every successful rebase.
repo_path_note: Leave empty to default to the repository containing patch-maint/. Set an absolute path only for an out-of-tree checkout.
base_ref: <full sha of your upstream base commit>
base_note: <how you chose the base, e.g. 'merge-base with upstream/main as of YYYY-MM-DD, just after desktop-vX.Y.Z'>

patch_commits.title: <commit subject>
patch_commits.area: <code area the patch touches, e.g. crates/buzz-cli>
patch_commits.drop_if: <the upstream PR/issue whose merge makes this carry obsolete — drop-on-adoption is the whole point>

watched_paths: <repo-relative files your patches touch — the conflict early-warning list>
adoption_patterns: <strings to grep upstream commits/diffs for, e.g. your flag names>

upstream_watchlist.note: free-form: PRs/issues to skim on every release

known_windows_test_failures: <test names that fail on your machine at the CLEAN base — verified environment artifacts only. A gate run passes iff its only failures are on this list.>
